initial_real_trace: The debugger experiment reused the initial real diagnostic output paths. Its trace is now retained as real.debugger.trace.json; initial real.summary.json and GNU time record remain the original run. Do not pair that initial summary with the overwritten trace.
report_baseline_trace: Use the separate duplicate-declarations.trace.json/summary.json pair for retained full-source phase evidence. It uses the exact original source with an extra compiler warning flag; no warnings were emitted. Diagnostic timings are not the focused benchmark cohort.
prototype_policy: Implementation-partition and namespace-std prototypes are rejected, not feature-equivalent performance evidence.
